name: Loucas Fourlas, Ruggero Razza - Après le § 1 - Am 1
title: REPORT on an EU health workforce crisis plan: sustainability of healthcare systems and employment and working conditions in the healthcare sector
part_text: 1a. Emphasises that healthcare professionals, including doctors, nurses, nursing assistants, pharmacists, midwives, paramedical staff, medical-technical staff, administrative staff and support staff, are the cornerstone of the functioning of European healthcare systems; recalls that their daily commitment ensures continuity of care, patient safety and the resilience of healthcare systems, particularly during times of crisis; believes that they must be fully recognised and placed at the heart of any strategy aimed at strengthening health care systems;
